clips.title: The story
paras: At Ironforge’s center, the Great Forge burns as the heart of the dwarven capital. Its furnaces and Great Anvil keep smiths at work, while the chamber draws people from across the mountain city.

The Great Forge was the first structure the early dwarves built beneath Ironforge Mountain. The capital grew in rings around it. Molten stone and slag flow from giant foundries into glowing channels, lighting the cavern with amber haze. At the center, Master of the Forge Myolor Sunderfury oversees the massive Great Anvil. Masters of metalwork gather around its rim, hammering armor, tools, and weapons day and night.

Smithing is only part of the Great Forge’s work. Guild offices, supply shops, and the city’s main gryphon roost ring the chamber. Gryth Thurden maintains the roost, where travelers from across the Alliance mingle amid the hammer blows.
